stock.description: This investment holding company operates and oversees a network of primary and secondary schools throughout the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. It delivers private educational services spanning primary, middle, and high school grades. Offerings extend to include international programs alongside specialized school-based electives covering subjects like sports, various arts, musical instruction, and traditional Chinese culture. Furthermore, the firm engages in providing educational consultancy and investment solutions. A significant part of its operations involves managing fifteen boarding schools. Established in 2002, the company's headquarters are situated in Dongguan, China.
